title: A rainy night in Jaén
text: The Guide was very informative and interesting. I learned a lot of history about Jaén. It rained, but that didn't stop us from traveling through Jaen.
author: LughOfTheLongHand

title: Good walk and interesting legends
text: Our visit was in Spanish, no problem as we are Spanish people, and I do not know why this page is in English. In any case, our guide Juan was very good and we got many explanations about the different legends in Almeria city, when we reached the planned stop points. He is very clear in his explanations  and we enjoyed so much with the walk.
author: AndresS2007
